approvalSource: Explicit user instruction in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-09-03 to remove public workspace type prefixes and their active source records from user pages and child services.
summary: Canonicalize all public workspace addresses to ekodi.kr/{slug} and child services to ekodi.kr/{slug}/{service}; keep workspace kind internal to workspace_id-backed data.
migrationPolicy: Breaking public-route simplification: typed public workspace route prefixes are retired from runtime and current source-of-truth records; reserved root slugs protect platform, common-service and core-service routes.
rollbackPlan: Revert the v1.5 orgless routing changes to restore the prior route model if staged verification detects workspace resolution, route collision, authentication return, or core-route regression.
